name: Melekeok (Palau)

colors.symbolism: the fimbriation between the rays and the central disc

description: A sunburst of red and dark blue rays separated by white fimbriation, with a white disc in the centre bearing the Palauan money bird holding chelbucheb money.

features.symbolism: Melekeok faces east, where the sun rises; the six sun rays stand for the six hamlets

features.role: the Palauan money bird (Bai-ra-Irrai, a Far Eastern curlew) holding chelbucheb money
